verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of skills (markdown process instructions plus hooks) installed into a coding-agent harness such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. It has no hosted service or backend of its own, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this product type. Its only working data is local, plan-scoped workspace files in the repo. Region choice belongs to whichever model provider or harness the user runs.
